Thanks for the ping — reading through their redline now. Quick answers up front: 

- Recommendation: For US state privacy (CCPA/CPRA) we accept the "service provider" classification and suggest explicit language that we process personal information on behalf of the controller and do not "sell" personal information. For international contexts (EU/UK) our position is to act as a "processor" under the DPA and follow controller instructions. We can propose a short clause that maps both terms to the same obligations (see suggested wording below).

Suggested two-sentence canonical clause (to paste into addendum):
"For the avoidance of doubt, and solely for the purposes of the CCPA/CPRA and other US state privacy laws, Redwood Inference shall be treated by Customer as a 'Service Provider' and shall only process Personal Information on behalf of Customer. For all other jurisdictions, Redwood Inference shall be deemed a 'Processor' under applicable data protection laws and will process Personal Data only on documented instructions from Customer; in all cases Redwood will apply contractual protections to limit onward transfers and require comparable obligations of its subprocessors."

- Subprocessors: attached is our internal export (subprocessor_manifest_20260820.csv) — marked columns indicate region and whether the subprocessors receive data outside the US. As a summary: our primary cloud infra provider and metrics vendor may have processing nodes in EU and APAC. We require written contracts with all subprocessors and perform annual audits for those handling sensitive data.

- Transfers: For EU-origin data we support latest version of SCCs (we can supply an executed SCC Annex), and we also offer the option of a more restrictive transfer addendum where we keep customer data within US-only regions on request (subject to deployment constraints). Key point: we do not rely on unspecified 'legitimate interest' arguments — we base transfers on SCCs or contractual safeguards.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Priyom to confirm with Elena whether Acme needs SCCs executed now or a general representation that we will execute them upon instruction.
2) Laura to review the proposed clause above and sign off.
3) If Acme wants a dataflow diagram listing infra providers and subprocessors, we can attach dataflow_diagram_acmecloud.png and the CSV to the addendum.

Let me know if you want me on the call with Acme.

Rishi Malhotra
